Frequently asked questions

From finding a suitable site to collecting a hot meal, find answers from our team.

Costs and partnership models

What would a machine cost at our site?

To prepare a quote, we look at regular footfall, shift patterns and the service you need. With your postcode and site type we can discuss suitable models on the first call.

Can we agree a fixed site rental?

Depending on the location, we can agree a fixed rental for the space. At busy sites, revenue sharing is also an option. The proposal sets out which costs each party covers.

How do employees pay at the machine?

Employees pay cashlessly at the machine. They see the price of their chosen meal before paying. Your team does not need to run a till.

Can we subsidise meals for our team?

Yes. Together we agree how much your company contributes per meal and how much employees pay. This lets you match the offer to your budget.

Can we offer meals without a subsidy?

Yes. Employees, guests or residents can pay the full price at the machine. An employer contribution is optional.

What if take-up is lower than expected?

An occasional quiet day does not automatically incur a penalty. We review the menu, the machine’s position and how people hear about it. Any contractual minimums are discussed before installation.

Installation and equipment

What makes a location worth assessing?

Locations with regular meal demand and gaps in canteen or restaurant hours are worth assessing. Examples include shift workplaces, offices, residences, hotels, gyms and transport hubs.

Which connections does the machine need?

The machine generally uses a 230-volt supply and a data connection. We check the intended circuit and available Wi-Fi or mobile coverage at the site.

How much space should we allow?

The machine is approximately 173 cm wide, 102 cm deep and 197 cm high. Allow room for customers, ventilation and restocking. For initial planning, set aside about two to three square metres and check delivery access with us.

How do I choose a meal?

The touchscreen shows the meals currently available. Select a dish and choose whether to have it heated or take it away chilled.

How is my meal heated?

The machine stores the meal chilled and heats it in its built-in microwave on request. Depending on the dish, heating takes about 45 seconds to two minutes. You then collect the packaged meal from the dispensing compartment.

Meals and quality

Where are the meals made?

We source ready-packed meals from food producers in Germany. The machine keeps them chilled at your site and heats individual meals on request.

How can I check a meal’s shelf life?

Check the best-before date and storage instructions on the individual pack. Shelf life varies with the recipe.

How often is the machine restocked?

We schedule visits around the location, stock levels and demand. If a dish regularly sells out first, we can adjust quantities or the selection on subsequent visits.

How do you limit food waste?

We track which dishes sell and when they reach their best-before dates. This informs ordering quantities and restocking schedules for each site.

Are there vegetarian and vegan options?

Vegetarian and vegan meals can be included depending on the location and menu. If part of your workforce eats plant-based, tell us when planning the selection.

Where can I check ingredients and allergens?

Check the label on the individual pack. If you have a question before buying, send us the dish name and location so we can check the relevant product information.

Pilot and support

Can we trial a machine first?

For suitable sites we can agree a pilot, for example over 90 days. Before launch, we agree how to assess demand and when to review whether to continue.

Who cleans and maintains the machine?

LECKERDING organises cleaning, refilling and technical support within the agreed service. Before launch, we arrange site access for these visits.

What should I do if the machine or dispensing process fails?

Send us the location, time and name of the dish. This helps us identify the transaction and agree the next step with you.

Who can I contact during the pilot?

Your site receives a direct contact for feedback and operational questions. For an initial enquiry, use the contact page or email info@leckerding.com.

What information should I include in a site enquiry?

Your postcode, site type, approximate number of users and the hours when hot meals are unavailable are enough to get started. A photo of the proposed spot can help us prepare useful follow-up questions.

Menu and everyday use

Can our team help choose the menu?

Yes. We can discuss dish preferences, dietary choices and meal options before the first fill. Later feedback helps shape future selections.

Does the menu change?

The selection can change with demand and our suppliers’ availability. The touchscreen shows what you can buy at the time.

Can I take a meal away for later?

Yes. Select chilled dispensing and follow the pack instructions for transport, storage and preparation.

Is cutlery available for eating on site?

Cutlery can be provided at the site. We agree an accessible place for it with the site partner.

How does LECKERDING differ from a break-room microwave?

The meals are already stocked on site. Guests choose a dish, pay and have it heated in the same machine. They can get a meal without bringing food from home or waiting for delivery.
